summary: Comprehensive testing of BidBlitz V2 Phase 3 Payment Architecture integration completed successfully. All new components (TopUpModal, TransactionDetailModal, TransactionFilters, PaymentRequestSummary) are properly integrated and working. Full payment flows tested including top-up with 90% success rate simulation and scanner payment with review step.

design_issues.note: Recharts library warning - does not affect functionality

Navigate to Wallet page via 'Get Started' button
Wallet page shows balance, premium card (ending 4821, ALEX MITCHELL, 09/28), quick actions (Add Money, Send, History)
Transaction filters work: All, Payments, Top-ups, Transfers - each filters correctly
Grouped transactions display by date (TODAY, YESTERDAY, etc.)

TopUpModal shows current balance, amount input, presets (€10, €25, €50, €100, €250, €500)
TopUpModal: select preset → Continue → Payment Method step with Card/Apple Pay/Google Pay/Bank Transfer
TopUpModal: Confirm processes payment with 90% success rate simulation
TopUpModal: Success state shows green checkmark and '+€50.00 Added to your wallet'
TransactionDetailModal opens when clicking on transaction (e.g., Uber Trip)
TransactionDetailModal shows: amount, status badge, reference, type, date, payment method
TransactionDetailModal: Copy Reference button works (shows 'Copied!')
Scanner page loads via bottom nav center button

Scanner page: Continue → Review step with PaymentRequestSummary

Scanner: Show QR Code → Scanning animation with laser line and progress bar

More page shows: Profile card (Alex, Premium badge), settings menu (Profile, Cards, Notifications, Security, Appearance, Settings, Help), Log Out, Version 2.0.0

Scanner close button returns to Home page

context_for_next_testing_agent: BidBlitz V2 is a pure frontend fintech app with no backend. All data is mocked via React Context API. TopUpModal has 90% success rate simulation (10% chance of 'Payment declined'). Scanner page hides bottom nav for full-screen. Mobile-first design (430px viewport recommended). Dark mode only.
